messages:
Ava (Design): quick design note — thinking about a small "pinned span" hint that appears when you keyboard-focus or hover a span in the trace viewer. shows a compact card with Span ID, Correlation ID, service, and 1-line message.
Marcus (Eng Runtime): sounds useful. does this require extra network calls? streaming traces are already heavy.
Ava (Design): no extra fetch — use the trace payload. it's purely client-side render. 
Priya (Product): support asks for an easy way to copy correlation id directly from the UI. one-click copy + analytics event?
Leo (Frontend): +1 for copy. implementation notes: keyboard focus must open the hint (not only hover). suggest `button` with `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and open with Enter/Space.
Maya (A11y): agree. must be accessible: focus trap if it's a dialog, ESC closes, tab order preserved, visible focus ring, and `aria-live` for copy confirmation. do not rely on hover alone.
Marcus (Eng Runtime): also a perf caveat — traces with 10k spans will render hints many times. we should lazy mount the hint DOM only when focused/hovered.
Sam (Eng-SRE): from ops POV, copying correlation id should surface a `trace.span.copy_correlation` event and include trace_id/span_id, but ensure no PII.
Ava (Design): copy button label — prefer explicit text: "Copy correlation ID" rather than terse "Copy". clarity > saving 2 chars.
Priya (Product): also think about short helper text inside the hint: "Correlation ID links related requests across services" — helps non-technical users.
Leo (Frontend): quick CSS prototype: `\n.pinned-hint { max-width: 320px; font-size: 13px; padding: 8px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); }\n.pinned-hint .meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }\n`
Maya (A11y): technical: use `aria-describedby` from the span button to the hint content, and `aria-atomic` for copy confirmation. also check contrast for the small meta text.
Ava (Design): placement question — should export/copy live in the top toolbar or inline in the drilldown? inline seems more discoverable when you're investigating a specific span.
Priya (Product): inline is my vote. reduces context switching for support.
Marcus (Eng Runtime): inline is okay but ensure export respects redaction configs and doesn't include env vars or full request bodies unless allowed.
Leo (Frontend): will prototype inline action menu: kebab -> [Copy correlation ID, Export trace (json), Open in new tab]. keyboard accessible.
DeployBot: deployment queued: frontend/proto/hints v2 -> staging at 2024-06-11 15:42 UTC :rocket:
Maya (A11y): one more nit — the pinned icon needs a text alternative. if it's decorative, use `aria-hidden`, otherwise give `aria-label="Show span details"`.
Ava (Design): ok can we convert to action items?
Priya (Product): +1, list please.
Ava (Design): Action items:
- Leo: prototype keyboard-accessible pinned-span hint (mount lazily), include copy button, PR by EOD Tue.
- Marcus: confirm payload size implications and add server-side redaction checks for export endpoints.
- Maya: run accessibility checklist on the prototype (focus management, aria roles, contrast).
- Sam: add analytics event spec for copy/export.
- Priya: write support blurb for the Console docs about correlation id usage.
Ava (Design): tagging folks: @Leo @Marcus @Maya @Sam @Priya 
Leo (Frontend): noted, I'll push a demo branch and drop a link here when ready. :thumbsup:
Marcus (Eng Runtime): will check perf and reply in thread by EOD.
Maya (A11y): happy to review the branch.
Priya (Product): thanks — this feels like a nice small improvement for investigation flows.
Sam (Eng-SRE): will coordinate analytics spec after Leo's branch.
Ava (Design): thanks team. closing loop after demo. :seedling:
